dreamteamer.title: Setup
dreamteamer.description: One board for every official dreamteamer module a workspace has: which optional capabilities are ready, which are degraded, and the fix for each. `dt-setup doctor` shows it and changes nothing. `dt-setup setup` makes only the in-workspace edits it asks for and prints the rest. `dt-setup link <clone>` previews a local clone of these modules. Ships no content.
